latest_release.name: Lantern 11.0.0
latest_release.body:
# Lantern v11.0.0 Release Notes

## New Features

- **Personal Proxies**: Share your connection with friends through secure invite links. Accept or decline friend requests, manage active proxies, and see real-time connection status.
- **Action Mode**: New dedicated mode for helpers sharing their connection. Auto-enable option available on launch, with improved UI and consent workflows.
- **Usage Statistics**: View on-device usage statistics with a new dedicated screen showing traffic breakdown.
- **Smart Routing Enhancements**: Added "Try Direct First" option to intelligently attempt direct connections before routing through VPN.
- **Sign in with Google and Apple**: Native in-app authentication on iOS for easier account management.
- **Include-only Split Tunneling**: New split tunneling mode to route only specific apps through VPN while keeping others direct.
- **WeChat Support**: Added WeChat to the list of apps kept off the Android VPN tunnel.
- **Android TV Improvements**: Enhanced remote-friendly UI across the Android TV experience.

## Improvements

- **Personal Proxy Reliability**: Enhanced friend discovery, live connection status indicators, and improved pairing mechanisms with better recovery from connection failures.
- **Onboarding**: Refined Personal Proxies and Action Mode introduction flows with improved timing and design consistency.
- **Helper Widget**: Better signaling and telemetry tracking for volunteer connections.
- **Windows Executable Selection**: Fixed matching logic for split-tunneling on Windows.
- **macOS Split Tunneling**: Properly integrated connection owner detection (FindConnectionOwner) in PacketTunnel.
- **Linux Support**: Fixed ability to open lantern:// links in the running app instance.
- **Translation Workflow**: Migrated from Transifex to AI-powered translation system for faster localization updates.
- **Telemetry**: Added optional logging integration with SigNoz for improved diagnostics (developer mode only).

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed corrupted shared_preferences.json recovery on Android.
- Resolved flaky Android Test Lab runs.
- Fixed Windows installer signing and runtime validation issues.
- Fixed RPM service installation on Linux.
- Fixed macOS status loop issue.
- Corrected split-tunneling bypass string translations in Farsi.
- Fixed circular dependency error when starting VPN in debug mode.
- Fixed debug-only CircularDependencyError at app startup.
- Fixed unread circular dependency error when starting VPN in debug mode.
- Fixed vulnerable Go dependencies in Android native library.

## Infrastructure & Dependencies

- Migrated to sing-box 1.14.2 for improved proxy protocol support.
- Upgraded OpenTelemetry SDK to 1.47.0 for better observability.
- Added golangci-lint, race detector, and govulncheck for Go code quality.
- Added stack canaries to Android native code for security hardening.
- Improved TestFlight upload reliability with better retry logic and timeout handling.
- Nightly builds now default to debug logging for improved diagnostics.
- Multiple updates to radiance, lantern-box, and broflake for personal proxy stability, volunteer direct exits, and obfuscated connections.

---

This is a production release from commit `d9b971b`.
